Generate the autocompletion script for powershell.

To load completions in your current shell session:

	ycy completion powershell | Out-String | Invoke-Expression

To load completions for every new session, add the output of the above command
to your powershell profile.

Usage:
  ycy completion powershell [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help              help for powershell
      --no-descriptions   disable completion descriptions

Global Flags:
      --log-format string   Diagnostic format: text or json
      --log-level string    Log level: debug, info, warn, or error
      --quiet               Only emit error diagnostics (short form: -q)
  -v, --verbose             Enable debug diagnostics
